messages:
Avery: Taking handoff from Jae — quick summary:
- No active incidents.
- Prefetch job finished for main pool; keep an eye on cache hit rate.
- PR #482 (kv-cache backpressure) needs one more reviewer.

Jae: Leaving a couple notes:
- Saw ~20 503s on embed-service at 01:30 UTC, retried and recovered. If it resurfaces, escalate to eng-runtime.
- Staging prewarm job completed: `kubectl rollout status deployment/prefetch -n staging`

Mia: FYI I'll run the batch-worker restart at 02:15 UTC (small risk of inflight eviction). Will post when done. :white_check_mark:

Priya: @Sam heads-up about canary: rolling 10% -> 50% tonight. Revert steps if needed:
```
./scripts/rollback.sh --canary
notify oncall-bot "canary-rollback"
```

deploy-bot: deployment/canary-release finished: commit abc123 -> live (canary 10%).

Sam: Ack. I'll watch the canary for 30m and post stats. :eyes:

Avery: Action items for next shift:
1) Confirm cache hit rate >= 85% for top-10 routes (dashboard link: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/cache).
2) Review PR #482 and merge if green.
3) Watch embed-service error rate; if >2% for 5m, open a bridge.
4) Confirm batch-worker restart completed (Mia to confirm).

Jae: Also updated the runbook section 'embed-service transient 5xx' with the retry backoff notes.

Mia: Batch-worker restart completed at 02:18 UTC — small bump in latency for ~40s then normal. Logged on ops dashboard.

Priya: Reminder: dedicated pool maintenance is tomorrow 03:00 UTC — not impacting tonight but FYI for next handoff.

Sam: All noted. Will take the shift for 12h and follow up if anything pops. Passing handoff to me.

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded — outgoing: Avery, incoming: Sam, duration: 12h. :spiral_calendar_pad:
